question: Do joint, validated functional resources predict trait re-expression and multigeneration reproduction beyond visible loss and dated lineage history?
claim_ceiling: Visible pigment loss is not proof of molecular competence loss
Homology or leaf RNA is not functionally complete floral pathway
A three-generation visible streak in the v10 toy chain is not flowering fitness or biological establishment
Pigmented migrants and introgressed alleles require distinct ancestral-history labels
Repeated published Petunia cases belong to a single clade
No universal clock time, universal reversal probability or causal pollinator effect has been established
independent_unit: whole phylogenetic clade or geographically independent lineage populations; not transcripts/photos/specimens from same individual
primary_event: experimentally or longitudinally documented true flower-trait re-expression in a lineage with historically recorded floral-expression loss
primary_mechanism: same-plant flower-scoped complete functional developmental/pigment modules measured jointly

candidate_clades.role: hypothesis origin, ancestry/functional competence not yet established
independent comparative molecular retention system with phylogenetically inferred, not experimentally causal, I. edule repigmentation
candidate historical trait reconstruction; functional validation pending
candidate functional regulator and negative mechanism screen
temporal flower-colour history candidate, not functional gene assay

admission_gates.criteria: Taxonomic identity, lineage ancestry and dating sufficiently resolved to orient loss and possible return
Visible phenotype verified in floral tissue at registered ontogenetic phase under comparable measurement
Functional joint genotype/developmental inventory from the same biological individual/lineage, appropriate organ and stage
admission_gates.no_substitute: pairwise modules, homology BLAST, leaf-only transcripts

admission_gates.criteria: Alternative mechanisms disentangled: retained activation, de novo sequence repair, introgression, already-coloured immigration, plasticity
Held-out entire clade/population predictive endpoint with temporal ordering and independent candidate controls
Reproductive/ecological relevance quantified via actual viable propagules/seed or specified trait function
admission_gates.no_substitute: three model snapshots or visible colour alone

model_comparisons: M0 present flower phenotype + environment + geography + declared taxonomic effects
M1 M0 plus independently reconstructed dated ancestry/colonisation
M2 M1 plus validated functionally joint retained modules and flower-scoped regulatory readiness
M3 M2 plus locus genealogy, cytotype and directional introgression/immigrant provenance
scoring: clade-heldout Brier and log loss, model calibration; no model selection after protected outcomes
external_generalization_gate: At least two independently admitted additional clades beyond Petunia and Cirsium, with positive and negative controls and prospective outcome qualification
research_source_screen: retrospective outcome-visible literature; NOT a prospectively qualified clade holdout
